chunks.rationale: test/sidebar.test.tsx describe 'Sidebar snooze nested submenu (#583)'. Click contract tests stay first. Keyboard tests use pressFocused (not press(el)) so a panel swap that drops focus to <body> fails instead of dispatching on a detached node. DOM-absent asserts are assert.ok(!node) — assert.equal(node, null) hangs on a circular fiber when the node is still present.
risks: Typeahead 'n' is pinned to next-week because 't' matches both This evening and Tomorrow. A future preset labelled 'Now' would steal that key.
ArrowRight tests focus [data-snooze-item] first. They do not prove the … trigger itself is in the tab order of the menu.

chunks.rationale: ThreadCard menu onKeyDown (Sidebar.tsx ~895). ArrowRight opens only when the event target is [data-snooze-item] and the panel is closed. ArrowLeft/Backspace go back only while snoozePanelOpen. Escape is not handled here — useEscapeClose still dismisses the whole menu. #582 stacking is untouched: data-menu-open on the card, .group:has([data-snooze-menu]) z-index 8.
risks: Backspace preventDefault only while nested. A focused menuitem never is an input, but if rename ever mounts inside this menu the key would steal characters.
This branch also carries the #583 drill-in markup (it was not on this worktree's main). Reviewers landing both PRs will see a conflict on Sidebar.tsx.

chunks.rationale: openSnoozePanel/closeSnoozePanel set pendingMenuFocus then flip snoozePanelOpen. A layout effect focuses the first preset (drill in) or the Snooze item (back) after the panel swap — the first-level trigger unmounts, so without this ArrowLeft has nothing focused. focusTypeaheadItem is prefix search with 500ms reset and same-letter cycling. Click handlers go through the same open/close helpers, so click still opens the panel; it also moves focus into it.
risks: Typeahead matches full textContent (wake times included). A digit can land on a preset whose whenLabel contains that hour.
No ArrowUp/Down roving tabindex. First-level navigation is still Tab.
data-snooze-preset / data-snooze-clear hooks are unchanged; pinSnooze.test.tsx still clicks through the nested panel.
Group :has([data-snooze-submenu]) was added in #583. Do not drop it — stacking while nested depends on it if the outer menu attribute were ever moved.
